items.title: 68357_Jimmy Maxwell oral history interview
items.q: And one day something happened and Ernesto wasn't around, and Ray Block took his own check over to the bank

ctx.x: I used to come into town, 8:00 in the morning, get home at midnight. But I always took my weekends off to be with the children. I never worked on Saturday or Sunday.

And one time Ernesto -- well, 35 years he used to pick up Ray Block's checks. 35 years he picked them up, and he took Ray's check to the bank and deposited it. And one day something happened and Ernesto wasn't around, and Ray Block took his own check over to the bank and tried to deposit it and they arrested Ray Block.
